title: Aether Security World - Evidence Item v0.1
description: One unit of evidence: a CLAIM ABOUT a world-state path, carrying provenance and trust metadata. This document is the AUTHOR-FACING form (what a world author or the AI seed generator writes) AND the ORACLE-FACING form (what the oracle classifies). Revision 1: `required_for_decision` was REMOVED from this schema - 'which facts the decision needs' is computed exclusively by the oracle from the ref closure of the in-scope policy/invariant set (see oracle-output.schema.json required_evidence[].decision_fact). Having it author-writable created three competing owners of the same fact and let a spec understate what a decision depends on.

asserts_ref.$comment: REVISION 1 (finding: three path syntaxes). The canonical fact key this item is evidence about. Grammar is the single ID-view BNF defined in design §4.3: <entity_type>.<entity_id>.<field...> where entity_type in {actor, resource, session, token, workflow, workflow_instance, cache, service, credential, role}. Example: 'resource.RES-001.owner', 'actor.ACT-003.privilege_version', 'session.SES-003.privilege_snapshot.privilege_version'. Action-binding views ('action.resource.owner') are NEVER stored here: compile_spec expands them to instance paths, and the oracle compares only canonical keys. A path that does not resolve in the compiled world is a Gate 2 build error.

value.$comment: The asserted value. May be null (claim of absence) or a composite object/array.

trust_level.$comment: trusted = system_of_record / signed auth state / deterministic DB state; semi_trusted = application logs / service metadata; untrusted = HTTP parameters, user-controlled headers, submitted text; derived = LLM summary / generated explanation / heuristic classifier output. REVISION 1: the establishing set is exactly TRUSTED_ESTABLISHES = {trusted, semi_trusted}, identical to configs/default.json evidence_masking.trusted_establishes. untrusted/derived evidence may only corroborate or contradict. NOTE this is the ORACLE's classification and is NOT part of the model-visible observation (design §5) - the model sees `provenance` and must infer trust, which is the actual skill being trained.

timestamp.description: VirtualClock value, never wall clock in the data path.

attacker_controllable.$comment: Independent of trust_level: a log line poisoned by injection is semi_trusted AND attacker_controllable. Oracle-facing only; not model-visible.

visible_in_observation.$comment: AUTHORITATIVE visibility flag (revision 1: single source of truth). world.evidence[].visible_in_observation is authoritative; EvidenceView and episode.observation.model_visible.evidence are projections of it, and Gate 2 asserts they agree.
